digest.component_or_area: MCP model schema generation and validation
propositions: BridgeFsckOut pydantic model declares three properties but bridge_fsck.schema.json declares four; binding_drift field is missing from the model despite being emitted unconditionally by the engine
VerifySignatureResultOut makes algorithm, head_sha, and key_id optional when the canonical schema requires all three
MCP models are hand-synchronized to JSON schemas with no generator or drift detection gate, unlike the TypedDict layer which uses gen_types.py with CI enforcement
Comments claiming cross-interface schema tests pin BridgeFsckOut, GroundingInfoOut, and WorkflowRunOut to canonical schemas are false; no such tests exist
The schema drift detection and synchronization pattern from schemas/gen_types.py and its CI check should be extended to cover the MCP model layer
